- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Augmented and virtual reality: Media companies will incorporate VR and AR into content creation for more immersive experiences as technology improves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shift towards subscription models: Publishers will emphasize subscription and membership models to generate income due to declining traditional advertising revenue.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] More focus on ethics and transparency: Media companies will become increasingly accountable for their reporting, focusing on accuracy, fairness, impartiality, and transparency.
